description: Land Acquisition - Nawali, Walikamam South-West D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition for public purpose under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired, including their locations, types (bare land, paddy field, garden, etc.), claimants, and extents. The content primarily deals with land matters, specifically government acquisition of property, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
